summary: Observe host seat admission state without blocking request paths

replay.detail: Observations and queue diagnostics stay in daemon memory.

schema.detail: No claim or database schema change.

rules.detail: Observe atomic state-file replacement and refresh every 30 seconds, with a freshness-expiry wake.

compatibility.detail: Admission remains disabled unless explicitly configured.

recovery.detail: Watcher failure falls back to periodic reads; stale or invalid observations admit with a diagnostic.
